description: Source code for LibMediaPlayerImpl class implementing media player functionalities, including initialization, event handling, and CAS data requests within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: LibMediaPlayerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of media player with CAS support, managing media sessions, callbacks, and environment setup.

methods.name: openMediaPlayer
methods.description: Initializes media player or CAS service based on session type, sets environment variables, and registers callbacks.

methods.name: closeMediaPlayer
methods.description: Stops and resets media player or CAS service based on session type.

methods.name: requestCASData
methods.description: Sends CAS data through the media player or CAS service instance.

methods.name: eventCallBack
methods.description: Handles media player events and forwards data to the session management.
